verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.mem0.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented product summary, and the docs are served as raw .md pages alongside a machine-readable openapi.json. The docs also include agent-targeted pages, such as agent self-signup and a CLI described as being 'for both humans and AI agents'. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually consume these docs well, and evidence on how complete llms.txt is (e.g. an llms-full.txt variant).
